lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Clusters of high-luminance circular blobs are arranged in a non-linear grid pattern posterior to the gill slits, with primary centroids concentrated in the mid-lateral zone showing varying diameters.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Multiple vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular blobs, creating a grid-like alignment where blobs are centered within the vertical stripes on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal side of the ridge and shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Five vertical branchial slits are clearly defined by high-contrast shadows on the anterior lateral surface.
